judged_text: poll_feed calls CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) and SimpleRSS returns nil for tags absent from an RSS item (RSS items have description, not content), so every poll of a plain RSS feed raises NoMethodError on nil.scrub and no item is ever imported. The hourly PollFeed job crashes on RSS feeds lacking atom:content on every run; feed polling silently produces zero topics and the failure is invisible because retry: false discards the exception.

adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, PollFeed#poll_feed does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` with no nil guard. If a feed item lacks `content` (e.g., only has `description`), `i.content` can be nil and this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub`, preventing any imports. The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so failures won’t be retried and can effectively result in perpetual non-importing behavior.
